description: Complete automated dropshipping workflow using Shopify, Alibaba, and Amazon

tasks.name: Product Research
tasks.description: Use ChatGPT to analyze trending products and niches
steps: Query ChatGPT for trending products in specific niches
Analyze profit margins and competition
Identify winning products with high demand and low competition
Generate list of 10-20 potential products daily
chatgpt_prompts: You are an expert dropshipping product researcher. Analyze the top trending products for dropshipping right now in the [NICHE] category. For each product, provide: (1) product name, (2) estimated retail price, (3) estimated supplier cost on AliExpress, (4) profit margin %, (5) competition level (low/medium/high), (6) monthly search volume estimate, (7) why it's trending, (8) ideal target audience. Return a ranked list of 15 products sorted by profit potential. Focus on products with 40%+ margins and low-to-medium competition.

Act as a dropshipping expert. I need you to identify 10 winning dropshipping products in the [NICHE] niche for [CURRENT_MONTH]. For each product: identify the pain point it solves, its wow factor, why customers would impulse buy it, the best platforms to sell on (Shopify/Amazon/eBay), and estimate the CPM advertising cost. Also suggest the best supplier regions and shipping time expectations.

Research and identify micro-niches within [BROAD_NICHE] that are underserved for dropshipping. List 5 specific micro-niches with: current monthly search trends, average order value potential, buyer demographics, seasonal demand patterns, and top 3 competitors. Recommend which micro-niche has the highest opportunity right now with lowest barrier to entry.

tasks.name: Supplier Sourcing
steps: Search Alibaba/AliExpress for products from research
Filter suppliers by rating, MOQ, and price
Compare multiple suppliers for best pricing
Save supplier contacts and product details

tasks.name: Product Listing Creation
steps: Use ChatGPT to generate SEO-optimized product titles
Create product descriptions with persuasive copy
Generate bullet points highlighting key features
Use Canva API to create product images and banners
Import listings to Shopify via API
chatgpt_prompts: You are a world-class Shopify copywriter and SEO expert. Create a complete product listing for [PRODUCT_NAME] targeting [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Include: (1) SEO-optimized title (under 70 characters, include primary keyword), (2) compelling product description (300-500 words with emotional hooks, benefits, and features), (3) 5 bullet points highlighting key features, (4) FAQ section with 5 common customer questions and answers, (5) meta description (under 160 characters), (6) 10 relevant SEO tags. Write in a tone that creates urgency and desire while being honest and compliant with advertising standards.

Write a high-converting Shopify product description for [PRODUCT_NAME] priced at $[PRICE]. The target customer is [DEMOGRAPHIC]. Use the PAS copywriting formula (Problem-Agitate-Solution). Include: a powerful opening hook (first 2 sentences must grab attention), the main problem the product solves, emotional pain points, product benefits (not just features), social proof placeholder, guarantee statement, and strong call-to-action. Make it 400+ words and SEO-friendly for the keyword '[PRIMARY_KEYWORD]'.

Generate 10 SEO-optimized product title variations for [PRODUCT_NAME] for a Shopify store targeting [TARGET_KEYWORD]. Each title should: be under 70 characters, include the primary keyword naturally, convey a clear benefit or unique selling point, and be compelling enough to increase click-through rate. Also provide a primary keyword, 5 secondary keywords, and 3 long-tail keyword phrases for this product.

tasks.name: Pricing Optimization
tasks.description: Automatically set competitive prices with profit margins
steps: Monitor competitor prices on Amazon and other stores
Calculate optimal price with 30-50% markup
Apply dynamic pricing based on demand
Update Shopify prices via API

tasks.name: Marketing Content Creation
steps: Create Facebook/Instagram ad copy with ChatGPT
Design ad creatives using Canva templates
Generate email marketing campaigns
Create social media posts for product promotion
chatgpt_prompts: You are an expert Facebook and Instagram ad copywriter who specializes in dropshipping products. Write 5 complete ad copy variations for [PRODUCT_NAME] targeting [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. For each variation include: (1) attention-grabbing headline (under 40 characters), (2) primary text (under 125 characters for best performance), (3) description text, (4) call-to-action button recommendation. Use different angles: problem/solution, social proof, urgency/scarcity, curiosity hook, and transformation story. Also suggest the 3 best audience interests to target on Facebook for this product.

Create a complete 7-day social media content calendar for promoting [PRODUCT_NAME] on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. For each day and platform, provide: post type (image/video/reel/story), caption (with hashtags), posting time, engagement hook, and call-to-action. Mix promotional content (30%) with value content (70%). Include trending audio suggestions for TikTok/Reels.

Write 3 email marketing sequences for [PRODUCT_NAME]: (1) A 3-email abandoned cart sequence with subject lines and full email bodies, (2) A 5-email post-purchase nurture sequence to increase reviews and repeat purchases, (3) A promotional email announcing a limited-time sale. Each email should have a compelling subject line, preview text, personalized opening, persuasive body, and clear CTA button text.

tasks.name: Order Fulfillment Automation
steps: Monitor Shopify for new orders via webhook
Extract order details and customer information
Automatically place order with supplier
Update customer with tracking information
Send confirmation emails

tasks.name: Customer Support Automation
steps: Monitor customer emails and messages
Use ChatGPT to generate responses
Handle common queries (shipping, returns, tracking)
Escalate complex issues to human review
chatgpt_prompts: You are a professional customer support specialist for an e-commerce dropshipping store. Write comprehensive, empathetic, and brand-consistent responses to these 10 common customer inquiries: (1) 'Where is my order?', (2) 'My item arrived damaged', (3) 'I want to return/refund my purchase', (4) 'The product doesn't match the description', (5) 'My order hasn't arrived after 30 days', (6) 'Can I change my shipping address?', (7) 'I received the wrong item', (8) 'How do I track my package?', (9) 'Is this product safe/quality?', (10) 'Can I get a discount?'. Each response should be professional, resolve the issue, retain the customer, and protect the business.

Create a complete customer support FAQ document for a dropshipping store that sells [PRODUCT_CATEGORY]. Include 20 questions and detailed answers covering: shipping times, returns policy, product quality, order tracking, sizing/compatibility, payment security, international shipping, and customer rewards. Format it to be easily copied into a Shopify FAQ page or chatbot knowledge base.

tasks.name: Inventory Management
steps: Monitor supplier inventory levels
Update Shopify stock quantities
Disable out-of-stock products
Re-enable when back in stock

tasks.name: Analytics and Reporting
steps: Pull sales data from Shopify
Calculate profit margins and ROI
Identify best-performing products
Create visual reports in Notion dashboard
Send summary email with key metrics

tasks.name: Product Testing and Optimization
tasks.description: Test products and optimize based on performance
steps: Analyze product performance metrics
Identify underperforming products for removal
Scale successful products with increased ad spend
A/B test product descriptions and images
